title: A ready start before bed
description: A short sequence of chosen material, with the sounds, the volume and the timer saved.

blocks.text: Once they have chosen, a person may want to repeat the same evening order without a fresh search. The review confirms that the sounds are personally useful, but it does not yet show whether a separate sequence of several items is needed.

quote.text: I love this app. I suffer with insomnia and the sounds this app offers are so helpful.

blocks.text: Let them put together a small set: one thing to listen to, say, and then the usual backdrop. Before the start, the order, the duration and the availability of every part are visible.
Test whether the person actually uses the sequence or just starts a single track every evening. In the second case a good saved mix is enough, and a separate ritual builder is surplus.
